import sys

def mabs(a):
    return -a if a < 0 else a

def main():
    # Read input values
    x, y, n = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split())

    a, b = 0, 1
    ans = 1e9
    d = float(x) / y

    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        l, r = 0, 1000000000
        while r - l > 10:
            m1 = l + (r - l) // 3
            m2 = r - (r - l) // 3
            t1 = mabs(d - float(m1) / j)
            t2 = mabs(d - float(m2) / j)
            if t1 > t2:
                l = m1
            else:
                r = m2
        for i in range(l, r + 4):
            v = mabs(d - float(i) / j)
            if ans - 1e-15 > v:
                ans = v
                a = i
                b = j

    print(f"{a}/{b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
